name: Dual Subgrid Marching Tetrahedra
definition: A dual surface reconstruction method for subgrid marching tetrahedra that improves accuracy by allowing output vertices to be placed freely rather than restricted to grid edges, preserving topologically distinct features when multiple polygons exist per tetrahedron.
summary: Dual Subgrid Marching Tetrahedra is a surface reconstruction technique that improves geometric accuracy by decoupling vertex positions from grid edges, preserving sharp features lost by edge-constrained methods.
